extracted_concepts.name: n-th order linear differential equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: y⁽ⁿ⁾ + a₁(x)y⁽ⁿ⁻¹⁾ + ... + aₙ(x)y = f(x)

extracted_concepts.name: homogeneous equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The form where f(x) = 0

extracted_concepts.name: nonhomogeneous equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The form where f(x) ≠ 0

extracted_concepts.name: linear independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: n solutions that are linearly independent

extracted_concepts.name: general solution of homogeneous
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: y = C₁y₁ + C₂y₂ + ... + Cₙyₙ for n independent solutions

extracted_concepts.name: general solution of nonhomogeneous
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Nonhomogeneous general solution = homogeneous general solution + particular solution

extracted_concepts.name: particular solution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: One specific solution to the nonhomogeneous equation

extracted_concepts.name: second order constant coefficient homogeneous ODE
aliases: 二阶常系数齐次线性微分方程
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: y'' + py' + qy = 0

extracted_concepts.name: characteristic equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: r² + pr + q = 0 derived from the ODE

extracted_concepts.name: distinct real roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ > 0 case: two distinct real roots r₁, r₂

extracted_concepts.name: repeated root
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ = 0 case: repeated root r

extracted_concepts.name: complex conjugate roots
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ < 0 case: α ± βi

extracted_concepts.name: discriminant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Δ = p² - 4q determines root type

extracted_concepts.name: undetermined coefficients method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method to find particular solution for f(x) = Pₘ(x)e^(λx)

extracted_concepts.name: variation of parameters method
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Method using known homogeneous solutions to find particular solution

extracted_concepts.name: characteristic root multiplicity k
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: k is the multiplicity of λ as a characteristic root

extracted_concepts.name: n-th order extension
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Extension from second order to n-th order using characteristic equation roots

extracted_concepts.name: superposition principle
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: General solution is linear combination of n independent solutions

extracted_concepts.name: exponential solution form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solution form involving e^(rx) from characteristic equation

extracted_concepts.name: oscillatory solution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solution involving cos βx and sin βx from complex roots

extracted_concepts.name: derivative core relation
aliases: 微分方程与导数的关系
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differential equations fundamentally involve derivatives - solving reverses differentiation

extracted_relations.evidence: homogeneous is the special case f(x)=0 of the general n-th order linear ODE
nonhomogeneous is the case f(x)≠0 of the general n-th order linear ODE
general solution requires n linearly independent solutions
nonhomogeneous general solution = homogeneous general solution + particular solution
nonhomogeneous general solution includes a particular solution

extracted_relations.source: second order constant coefficient homogeneous ODE
extracted_relations.evidence: characteristic equation r²+pr+q=0 represents the ODE y''+py'+qy=0
discriminant Δ determines the type of roots
Δ>0 gives two distinct real roots
Δ=0 gives repeated root
Δ<0 gives complex conjugate roots
distinct roots give solution y = C₁e^(r₁x) + C₂e^(r₂x)
repeated root gives y = (C₁+C₂x)e^(rx)
complex roots α±βi give y=e^(αx)(C₁cosβx+C₂sinβx)
undetermined coefficients finds particular solution for Pₘ(x)e^(λx) type
variation of parameters finds particular solution using homogeneous solutions
variation of parameters requires known homogeneous general solution
k is the multiplicity of λ as a characteristic root, used in setting up y*

extracted_relations.target: second order constant coefficient homogeneous ODE
extracted_relations.evidence: n-th order extends the second order method using n characteristic roots
superposition principle states general solution is linear combination of independent solutions

extracted_relations.evidence: second order constant coefficient ODE is a special case of n-th order linear ODE
